description: This file defines the Element class within the Goteo\Library\NormalForm namespace. It implements interface methods for ArrayAccess and Resource, manages form element properties, and provides methods for rendering HTML views related to form elements.

classes.name: Element
classes.description: Represents a form element with properties such as id, type, title, class, hint, and methods to render and manage its HTML representation.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property by name.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets the value of a property by name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Element object with given data, processes children, and sets the view and type.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the view path for rendering the element.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the element based on class name.

methods.name: getInnerHTML
methods.description: Returns the HTML content of the element by rendering its view.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static method to instantiate an Element and render it.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the element by invoking the view.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the element to string by rendering it, with exception handling.
